# MACONA — Mimi African Charities of North America

> 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing relief and support for children and women in Africa and the Greater Baltimore Area. EIN: 93-3813688. 100% volunteer-driven.

## Mission
Build a world where all youth are cared for, safe, and never go to bed hungry. MACONA provides healthcare, education, nutrition, and clothing to children in West Africa and the Greater Baltimore Area.

## Donate
- $5 clothes one child: https://go.macona.org/donate-5
- $10 feeds a child for two weeks: https://go.macona.org/donate-10
- $25 clothes five children: https://go.macona.org/donate-25
- $50 supports a family: https://go.macona.org/donate-50
- $100 funds a community project: https://go.macona.org/donate-100
- General donation: https://go.macona.org/donate
- Corporate match via Benevity: search "Mimi African Charities" (EIN 93-3813688)

## Programs
- Clothing Drives: School supply and clothing collection from US schools, shipped to West Africa
- Nutrition: Meal programs for children in Bamako and surrounding communities
- Education: School supplies, tutoring, and scholarship support
- Healthcare: Medical supply drives and community health initiatives
